notes: Needler: heron-like ceremonial sentry. Static stepped ivory plinth with thin gold bands; rotating ivory skull head with a black visor band, a long gold needle along -Y (art direction == locked attack direction) and a swept crest plus fins behind, so the head reads as an arrow from the high game camera. Head scaled 1.25x as a whole (baked into the mesh; node scale 1) for phone readability. Bolts spawn visually at needler_muzzle on the needle tip (~0.71 m ahead of the rotation axis after scale; the needle intentionally exceeds the 1.3x radius guideline because it IS the direction cue).
